split.discipline: gold-passage component-disjoint across dev, validation, and exposed held-out splits

judgment_protocol: 0/1/2 relevance judgments are developer-authored. They were originally written before scorer output was consulted. Passage text and provenance were subsequently corrected during audit; the grades were carried forward and have not been independently reviewed or re-authored. Treat them as provisional.
held_out_status: EXPOSED: case IDs and membership are published in this manifest, and lexical results are documented. It is not a blind test set.
usage: Do not use the exposed held-out split as a blind test for a future JEV comparison or for tuning. Any future confirmatory JEV comparison requires a new, independently judged, previously unseen set under a frozen protocol.
